_comment: User-facing strings for Liar's Dice. Bracketed action tokens ('[Bid: X, Y]', '[Call]'), player ids, dice face values, quantities and counts are neutral slots and must never be translated.

_slots.num_players: number of players in the game (integer)
_slots.your_dice: pre-rendered comma-joined list of this player's dice face values
_slots.d: remaining dice count for that player (integer)
_slots.loser_id: player index who loses a die (integer)
_slots.action: the raw action string the player submitted
_slots.final_ranking: list of player indices from first eliminated to winner

player_prompt.intro:
UnguMdlali {player_id} kwenye umdlalo we-Liar's Dice wenye {num_players} abadlali.
Imithetho:
- Kwenye ilixa lakho, unaweza ukwenza:
  1) Yenkqubo entsha yenye inqwaba ephezulu okanye iamanani asematshana ephezulu (okanye zombini) kuliko inkqubo yamanje; isebenza, '[Bid: 3, 4]',
  2) Yitshayele inkqubo yokugqibela ngokutshayela '[Call]'.

Ukuba uyitshayele:
  - Ukuba inani lamatshana asematshana kwenye zonke amatshana liphantsi kwenye inkqubo, umdlali othathe umatshana uyakulahlekelwa.
  - Kungenjalo, oyitshayele uyakulahlekelwa.
Umdlali othathe umatshana awunayo uyapheliswa. Omdlali oshiyekileyo ophumelela.

board.new_round:
Isiphepho esintsha - Iintshiselele ezisesele: {dice_summary}
Iintshiselele zakho zisenza: {your_dice}

call.bidder_loses:
Mdlali {current_player_id} ethetha! Inani elingaphezulu lezi ntshiselele {face_value} li {count}, elingaphezulu kwakhona {quantity}.
Mdlali {loser_id} (omdlali ophelile) uphume inyanga.
call.caller_loses:
Mdlali {current_player_id} ethetha! Inani elingaphezulu lezi ntshiselele {face_value} li {count}, elingaphezulu kwakhona {quantity}.
Mdlali {loser_id} (omethethi) uphume inyanga.

invalid_move.not_recognized: Aktioni ayatambulwa njengokuthi '[Bid: X, Y]' noma '[Call]' yodwa. Aktioni ethunyelwe: {action}

bid_reason.face_range: Ixabiso elibonakalayo kufuneka libe phakathi kwe-1 ne-6.
